name: hxscript
description: An advanced Haxe interpreter. It parses Haxe-shaped source and evaluates it directly, with enough of the language intact that a script can declare classes, enums, typedefs and abstracts, and extend the ones your application already compiled, with declared types enforced at runtime. On hxcpp and HashLink it can also translate a module to native bytecode while your application is running, with no Haxe toolchain installed, which is what lets a script that arrives after your release run at close to compiled speed.
